primitives.note: Permanent Stardust stacks (Cosmic Creator) scale Q's per-target-max-HP bonus damage, E's execution threshold, and unlock R's upgraded Skies Descend form at 75 stacks; the sim must assume a starting stack count for the 15s fight.
Q's beam ticks damage every 0.125s to the primary target (50% to secondary targets) while channeled; E's black hole ticks damage every 0.25s over its 5s duration.
Breath of Light is a channel (up to 3.25s at ranks 1-4, effectively unlimited at rank 5 or during Astral Flight) that is interrupted by attacking, moving, or hard-casting.

Q layers a separately-timed per-second burst on top of its continuous beam tick and auto-recasts at max channel duration; The Skies Descend has a separately timed impact and an expanding 3s shockwave, with targets hit by the impact excluded from the shockwave.
Astral Flight fully resets Breath of Light's cooldown (and removes its max duration/cost pacing) on cast, and refunds 90% of its own cooldown on a takedown.
While channeling Breath of Light during Astral Flight's dash, Q's non-burst flat damage is increased by 108-112%.
Enemies within the center of Singularity's black hole are executed below 5% (+Stardust scaling) of their maximum health.
Breath of Light's per-full-second burst deals bonus damage scaling with the target's maximum health, in addition to its flat+AP component.
Breath of Light incurs an ongoing mana-per-second cost starting 1.25s into the channel, on top of E's and R's flat 90/100 mana costs, which can meaningfully constrain casts across a 15s fight.

needsBespoke.why: Aurelion Sol's damage output depends on a live-updating Stardust stack counter that simultaneously feeds three different formulas (Q's true-damage-vs-max-HP burst, E's execution threshold, and R's Falling Star->Skies Descend transform at exactly 75 stacks) while itself growing from the very abilities being simulated in the fight. Q also runs two independently-timed damage processes at once (a continuous 0.125s beam tick and a 1s-interval burst that resets if the burn lapses), and W can reset/extend that channel mid-fight and multiplicatively buff only its non-burst portion. Modeling this correctly needs bespoke state-tracking beyond a static combination of the listed primitives, not just tagging which primitives apply.

proposal: Open by casting R (Falling Star, or The Skies Descend if the assumed Stardust count has it unlocked) on the dummy first, since its long cooldown (100-120s) means it only fires once in the 15s window and its impact has a 1.25-2s travel delay.
Immediately begin channeling Q (Breath of Light) on the dummy and hold the channel as long as possible to maximize both the continuous beam tick damage and the once-per-second burst bonus.

Cast E (Singularity) on the dummy as soon as it is available (12s cooldown, mana permitting) to add its own DPS tick and execute threshold pressure, accepting that this may interrupt the ongoing Q channel.
Immediately re-open the Q channel after E resolves and keep it running.

Use W (Astral Flight) toward/through the dummy partway through the fight to instantly reset Q's cooldown/duration and gain the 108-112% flat damage buff on Q while flying, then let Q auto-continue at the buffed rate.
Recast E again near the end of the 15s window if its cooldown and mana allow a second cast.
Keep Q channeling continuously in every remaining gap, since its cooldown is only 3 seconds and it is the primary sustained damage source.
